title: LUNAR Lab website launches
description:
We are excited to officially launch the new LUNAR Lab website — a central hub for our research, publications, team, and news.

The site has been built with a focus on clarity and accessibility, making it easy for collaborators, prospective students, and the broader research community to learn about our work. Visitors can browse our full publication list, filter by topic or tag, and access papers and code directly through linked repositories.

The design reflects the identity of the lab: grounded in both scientific rigor and a curiosity about the nature of language and mind. We wanted the site to feel thoughtful and open, much like the research questions we pursue.

In the coming months, we will be expanding the site with individual researcher profiles, a more detailed project pages section, and a reading group archive. If you are a current or prospective collaborator and notice something missing or have a suggestion, please reach out — we welcome feedback.

Thank you to the student developers who built this site and to everyone in the lab who contributed content and feedback during the review process.
